3

Complete Battle Frameworks

Use AREA for defensive plays (when competitor comes up) and IDEA for offensive plays (when you bring up competitor).

🔍 Acknowledge

Validate their concern. Don't dismiss the competitor.

🔄 Redirect

Pivot to what matters most for this customer.

📊 Evidence

Provide proof points that support your position.

❓ Ask

Close with a discovery question to move forward.

💡 Introduce

Bring up the competitor strategically.

🎯 Differentiate

Highlight your key differentiators.

📈 Elevate

Raise the conversation to business outcomes.

🤝 Advance

Propose a concrete next step.

🎓 How to Use the Competitive Analysis Skill

Use this skill in Joule to generate complete battle cards and competitive intelligence.

💬

Trigger Phrases

  • "Battle card for [competitor]"
  • "How do we compete against..."
  • "AREA framework for Oracle"
  • "Competitive positioning vs..."
  • "Win against [competitor]"
📝

Sample Prompt

"Create a battle card for SAP S/4HANA vs Oracle Cloud ERP. Include AREA defensive framework, IDEA offensive framework, and top 3 landmines to set. Focus on manufacturing industry."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Competitive Matrix — Side-by-side capability comparison
  • AREA Framework — Defensive talk track
  • IDEA Framework — Offensive positioning
  • Landmines — Questions that expose competitor weakness
💡

Pro Tips

  • Be specific — Include industry and deal size
  • Ask for objections — "Common objections and rebuttals"
  • Request proof points — "Customer references who switched"
  • Get landmines — "Questions to expose their weakness"
